# Stickblade Arena

> Physics-based LLM benchmark. Two language models sword-fight in a 2D
> pymunk-simulated arena. Humans vote blind on which AI fought smarter.
> Per-model Elo ratings track performance across weapons, arenas, and
> "sharp zone" configurations that reward different tactical approaches.

Stickblade Arena is a running LLM evaluation experiment, not a game. It
tests physical/spatial reasoning that text-only benchmarks (MMLU, GPQA,
HumanEval) cannot measure. Each match is a real API round-trip: 24 roster
entries — 18 LLMs (10 OpenRouter free-tier + 6 Groq + 2 OpenRouter paid)
plus 4 non-LLM baseline bots (random / greedy / distance-holder /
scripted-pro) and 2 scripted mock brains — compete every turn (3 seconds
of physics, ~15 seconds of LLM thinking). Users vote without seeing model
identities. Elo ratings update per-vote using Elo K=32.

Verified live count: `curl https://pioneer37-stickman-arena.hf.space/api/models | jq length`
(this file may drift; the API is authoritative).

## Live surfaces

- [Frontend (play + vote)](https://stickblade-arena.vercel.app): the live product — pick two models, watch them fight, vote blind.
- [Backend API](https://pioneer37-stickman-arena.hf.space): FastAPI on HuggingFace Spaces, JSON round-trips per turn.
- [Backend API docs](https://pioneer37-stickman-arena.hf.space/docs): auto-generated OpenAPI (Swagger UI) for `/api/*` endpoints.
- [Source (GitHub)](https://github.com/Cometbuster4969/STICKBLADE-ARENA): Apache 2.0 licensed monorepo (Python backend + Next.js frontend).
- [METHODOLOGY.md](https://github.com/Cometbuster4969/STICKBLADE-ARENA/blob/main/METHODOLOGY.md): canonical write-up — motivation, per-turn protocol, 6-axis Elo, threats to validity.
- [TIMELINE.md](https://github.com/Cometbuster4969/STICKBLADE-ARENA/blob/main/TIMELINE.md): shipping log + roadmap + kill list.
- [HF Space page](https://huggingface.co/spaces/Pioneer37/Stickman-Arena): backend deployment surface on HuggingFace.
- [Match export endpoint](https://pioneer37-stickman-arena.hf.space/api/export): full match log dump (JSON + JSONL streaming) for external analysis.
- [Vote-rate stats](https://pioneer37-stickman-arena.hf.space/api/stats/vote_rate): live human-vote-through metrics.

- Google AI Overview: "a brilliant example of gamified AI evaluation" (spontaneous citation without prompting).

## What it evaluates

Traditional LLM benchmarks measure text tasks. Stickblade tests:

- Spatial reasoning under uncertainty — "how do I position my body when
  the opponent is 72px away and I'm at 59 HP?"
- Multi-step planning with physics constraints — momentum, gravity,
  swing cooldowns, sharp-zone geometry all matter for damage calc.
- Tool use with rules — each weapon has different move sets, ranges,
  and sharp-zone rules that models must reason about correctly.
- Adversarial reasoning — models see the enemy's last move and must
  counter without being told what to do.

## Architecture

- Backend: Python 3.13, FastAPI, pymunk 6.x physics engine. ~1300-line
  `brains.py` with per-provider adapters (OpenRouter, Groq) + reasoning-
  parameter policy engine + 429 circuit breaker + provider-diverse
  buddy failover.
- Frontend: Next.js 15, React 19, deployed on Vercel. Canvas-based
  renderer (`player.js`) walks recorded frames for replay playback.
- Storage: Supabase (Postgres) with atomic `apply_elo_vote()` RPC for
  race-free rating updates. SQLite fallback for local dev.
- Deploy: HuggingFace Spaces (Docker) for backend, Vercel for frontend,
  two-remote git setup.

## Models on the roster (as of 2026-08)

18 LLMs (10 OpenRouter free-tier + 6 Groq + 2 OpenRouter paid) plus 4
non-LLM baseline bots and 2 mock brains. Total roster: 24. Covering:

- Reasoning-optimized: openai/gpt-oss-20b, gpt-oss-120b (both Groq and
  OpenRouter), deepseek-r1-distill-llama-70b, nemotron-3 super/ultra
- Mid-tier chat: llama-3.3-70b-versatile, kimi-k2-instruct
- Small / fast: llama-3.1-8b-instant, nemotron-nano-9b-v2, gemma-4
- Non-LLM baselines: `bot:random` / `bot:greedy` / `bot:distance` /
  `bot:pro` — Elo noise-floor references for the LLM roster.

Dead slugs removed 2026-07 after live 404s: llama-4-scout-17b, qwen3-32b
(both Groq deprecated); yanked-to-paid OpenRouter free slugs (10 total).
See TIMELINE.md § "UX polish + provider-roster maintenance" for the full
deprecation ledger.

## Bias & limitations (honest disclosure)

- Sample sizes per model are still small (~hundreds of matches); Elo
  confidence intervals are wide. Do not cite a specific rating as
  authoritative yet. See the [cross-benchmark correlation
  report](https://github.com/Cometbuster4969/STICKBLADE-ARENA/blob/main/research/cross_benchmark_correlation_report_2026-08-04.md)
  for the published null finding.
- Vote is single-annotator per match; inter-rater agreement is not yet
  measured. Roadmap: switch to opt-in multi-vote sample + Cohen's κ.
- `PROMPT_VERSION` is pinned per match; bumping it invalidates historical
  Elo comparisons across versions. Currently at version 1.
- Human judges are self-selected (mostly Reddit / HN / PeerPush traffic);
  demographic bias is not measured.

## Related work

- [Chatbot Arena (LMSYS)](https://lmarena.ai/): reference for blind human
  evaluation of LLMs, but text-only.
- [MMLU (Hendrycks et al 2020)](https://github.com/hendrycks/test): static
  multi-subject Q&A benchmark; suffers training-data contamination as it ages.
- [HELM (Stanford CRFM)](https://crfm.stanford.edu/helm): holistic evaluation
  framework; task-based, text-only.
- [Habitat (Meta AI)](https://aihabitat.org/) and [AI2-THOR](https://ai2thor.allenai.org/):
  physics-grounded / embodied AI benchmarks; test spatial reasoning but in
  controlled single-agent environments, not adversarial multi-agent competition.
